Package org.example

Class Expression

java.lang.Object
org.example.Expression
Direct Known Subclasses:
Binary, Number, Variable
public abstract class Expression extends Object
The abstract base class representing a mathematical expression tree node. Provides the core interface for evaluating, differentiating, simplifying, and stringifying mathematical expressions.

      protected abstract int eval(HashMap<String,Integer> signifying)
      Evaluates the expression by substituting variable values from the provided map. This method must be implemented by subclasses to handle variables and operations.
      Parameters:
      signifying - a map containing variable names as keys and their corresponding integer values as values
      Returns:

    • eval

      protected abstract int eval()
      Evaluates the expression assuming it contains no variables. This method must be implemented by subclasses to calculate constant values.
      Returns:
      the integer result of the evaluation
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the expression contains unresolved variables

    • eval

      public int eval(String signifyingString)
      Evaluates the expression using a string that specifies variable assignments.
      Parameters:
      signifyingString - a string containing variable definitions, e.g., "x = 2; y = 3"
      Returns:
      the integer result of the evaluation after parsing and applying the variables
      Throws:
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if the input string format is invalid
      NumberFormatException - if a variable value cannot be parsed into an integer
